items.title: Keep the pre-fight CTA fully inside the portrait viewport
items.what: On the Qualifier intro screen at 390x844, the FIGHT button is centered around y=870, so only its top edge and text are visible at the bottom of the screenshot; most of the rounded button extends below the viewport.
items.why: The primary action is partially clipped exactly when the player needs to start the bout, making the game look broken and reducing the usable tap target.
items.how: Reserve a fixed bottom-safe-area region for the CTA, position it above the control deck with bottom: 16px plus env(safe-area-inset-bottom), and verify the full button remains visible at 390x844.

items.title: Make loading progress visibly communicate movement
items.what: On the ShoeMoney pre-boot screen, the 'Downloading the game' message sits above a long progress track that appears uniformly dark with no visible fill, percentage, or byte status.
items.why: The player cannot tell whether downloading is progressing or stalled, which creates an immediate abandonment risk before gameplay starts.
items.how: Fill the track proportionally with the existing gold accent, add a numeric percentage or 'x MB / y MB' below it, and show explicit stalled/error text with Retry after a timeout.

items.title: Separate hit confirmation from move-name notifications
items.what: In the impact screenshot, the large IPPON confirmation around y=250 overlaps the dark 'SPINNING BACK KICK' callout directly beneath it, causing the two messages to visually merge over the fighters.
items.why: The most important combat feedback is difficult to parse during the hit moment, so players may miss whether they scored and which move caused it.
items.how: Give hit results and move names separate vertical lanes: reserve the upper center for IPPON/score feedback and place move names below it, with a minimum 12px gap and independent fade timings.

items.title: Stop the win screen from stacking result labels
items.what: On the HasanAbi wins screen, the 'ROUNDHOUSE KICK' notification is partially hidden behind the 'BOUTS WON 0 / 1' pill around the center of the result overlay.
items.why: The end-of-round screen looks like two systems are fighting for the same space, and the obscured move label makes the decisive event harder to understand.
items.how: Clear transient move notifications when entering the result state, or move them into a dedicated line above the score with a fixed layout that never overlaps the winner, score, or bout summary.

items.title: Use the wide layout instead of leaving the arena controls stranded
items.what: In the landscape gameplay screenshot, the dojo ends around y=570 and the two small sticks sit at the extreme lower-left and lower-right corners, leaving most of the large black control area empty between them.
items.why: The controls become harder to reach and visually disconnected from the playfield, while the wide viewport wastes space and makes the interface feel like an unadapted portrait layout.
items.how: Either lock the game to portrait with an orientation prompt, or implement a landscape layout that enlarges and vertically centers both sticks, adds a central action/status region, and keeps each control within comfortable thumb reach.
